result.summary: Found 3 issues: content is cut off at the horizontal edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' section, a restaurant name is truncated, and there's an unlabeled/empty circular avatar element in the top right.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section cuts off the third card (Trattoria Piccolo) at the screen edge, showing only a partial view which looks broken rather than indicating scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue like a peek of the next card with proper padding or a fade gradient to indicate horizontal scrolling is available

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without ellipsis styling, cutting off mid-word at the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses proper ellipsis or reflows within visible card boundaries

issues.description: Empty gray circular avatar/profile icon in the top right corner has a small red dot notification but no visible icon or image inside it
issues.suggestion: Add a profile icon or user image placeholder inside the circle for clarity
